title: bot.ability.hearing.voice.diarization.output
description: Provider-neutral diarization result for voice input.

segments.description: Clipped audio segments ordered by ascending start time in the voice input. Each segment retains its timing and optional diarization confidence.

items.description: One clipped, time-bounded audio segment produced by voice diarization.

audio.description: Raw signed 16-bit PCM audio clipped to this voice segment. floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes: audio is a reference (a URI reference) to a file in the directory the run grants [floppy field].
audio.title: Audio

media_type.description: Media type of the raw PCM bytes in this voice segment.
media_type.title: Media Type

sample_rate_hz.description: Sample rate of the raw PCM bytes in this voice segment, in hertz.
sample_rate_hz.title: Sample Rate Hz

channels.description: Channel count of the interleaved raw PCM bytes in this voice segment.
channels.title: Channels

start_seconds.description: Inclusive start time of this voice segment, measured from the beginning of the source audio.
start_seconds.title: Start Seconds

end_seconds.description: Exclusive end time of this voice segment, measured from the beginning of the source audio.
end_seconds.title: End Seconds

confidence.description: Optional provider confidence for this speaker attribution, normalized from 0.0 to 1.0.
confidence.title: Confidence

items.title: VoiceDiarizationSegment

segments.title: Segments
